checks.coverage: Current mate bindings, joint axes/limits, pose presets and animation targets; cooler follows the board. No motion collision sweep.

checks.purpose: Explicit component roles and print-export selection
checks.coverage: Every part script, active model variant and assembly occurrence classified; only active printed parts export; purchased hardware and review volumes excluded; metadata-only, no printability certification.

checks.purpose: Saved assembly inventory and placed geometry
checks.coverage: Expected occurrence labels/order/count; saved solid counts, placed bounds and volumes. No all-pairs robot collision study.

checks.purpose: Radxa mount, GPIO jumper and cable fit
checks.coverage: Saved rest pose; 1e-5 mm3 overlap threshold; mounting context and GPIO allowances against the assembly, PCB seating, mounting axes, screw passages/head seats, speaker mount and bearing passages. Physical wire bending and tool access untested. Explicit approximate underside button keepout and minimum bracket gap; actual actuator height/position unmeasured. One continuous open carrier, four PCB screw seats, open button-side strip between screw islands, no other PCB contact at the seating plane.

checks.purpose: Cooler envelope, fan inlet and cover wall fit
checks.coverage: Saved rest pose; official outer envelope and modeled inlet, 1e-5 mm3 overlap threshold, five cover-wall samples >=2 mm and nominal mounting stack. Detailed cooler geometry approximate; no thermal validation.

checks.purpose: Stick pod, tongue screws, print gaps and adapter spaces at rest
checks.coverage: Valid single-solid trunk, pod and shells; seated battery bounds; shell split (0.6 mm), shell-pod (0.35 mm) and battery gaps; static overlaps of the five changed parts with every occurrence, the pod touching only the trunk; tongue contact area; two M3 bores, head seats, insert pilots, 1.5 mm insert walls, shank and 3 x 60 mm driver paths; four adapter review volumes free. Stick, latch and contacts are APPROXIMATE. No slicing, physical fit or strength test.

checks.purpose: All 1702 recorded walking and sitting keyframes against the stick battery, pod, trunk and shells
checks.coverage: Thirty leg occurrences; 1702 keyframes; 1 mm minimum gap; 2 mm conservative bounds rejection and exact distance on nearby pairs. Not a continuous sweep or independent joint range guarantee.

checks.purpose: Straight-down stick release at the home pose, hook travel through the lips and button thumb room
checks.coverage: Home pose; full 95 mm straight-down release. Battery material inside the stick outline grown 0.3 mm is proven clear of every part by its swept column; outside pieces are proven clear by swept boxes or checked with exact booleans every 0.25 mm where a swept box meets a part. Rigid hooks may overlap the pod only inside the lip zone and within the flex room; empty flex room; thumb room outside both buttons. APPROXIMATE latch; no arm bending, button force or physical fit.

checks.purpose: Printed stick pod: geometry, wall, skin symmetry, edges, voids, holes and the two tongue screws
checks.coverage: Stick pod only, as saved. Checkers first find the error in known-error fixtures. 0.05 mm short edges, 0.05 mm2 small and 0.1 mm narrow faces; 1.2 mm ray-cast wall (0.5 mm samples; rays leaving a face at under 25 degrees are left to the edge check); mirror symmetry of the outer 1 mm skin; outside edges rounded 0.5 mm or named; closed voids; support area for six build directions (reported); every hole owned by a fastener; bd_warehouse M3 ISO 4762 screws in CNC Kitchen inserts. Accepted problems are named boxes at most 40 mm a side and within 2 mm of their findings. No slicing, strength or physical fit test.
